info.name: Webex Admin Address Book SCIM 2 Groups API

params.name: orgId
params.description: The ID of the organization to which this group belongs. If not specified, the organization ID from the OAuth token is used.

params.name: filter
params.description:
The url encoded filter. The example content is 'displayName Eq "group1@example.com" or displayName Eq "group2@example.com"'.
For more filter patterns, see https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7644#section-3.4.2.2. If the value is empty, the API returns all groups under the organization.

params.name: attributes
params.description: The attributes to return.

params.name: excludedAttributes
params.description: Attributes to be excluded from the return.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: A string indicating the attribute whose value be used to order the returned responses. Now we only allow `displayName, id, meta.lastModified` to sort.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: A string indicating the order in which the `sortBy` parameter is applied. Allowed values are `ascending` and `descending`.

params.name: startIndex
params.description: An integer indicating the 1-based index of the first query result. The default is 1.

params.name: count
params.description: An integer indicating the desired maximum number of query results per page. The default is 100.

params.name: includeMembers
params.description: Default "false". If false, no members returned.

params.name: memberType
params.description: Filter the members by member type. Sample data: `user`, `machine`, `group`.

items.docs:
Retrieve a list of groups in the organization. Long result sets are split into [pages](/docs/basics#pagination).
**Authorization** An OAuth token rendered by Identity Broker.
One of the following OAuth scopes is required: - `identity:people_rw` - `identity:people_read`
The following administrators can use this API: - `id_full_admin` - `id_group_admin` - `id_readonly_admin` - `id_device_admin`

items.docs:
Returns the members of a group. - The default maximum number of members returned is 500. - Control parameters are available to page through the members and to control the size of the results. - Long result sets are split into [pages](/docs/basics#pagination). **Note** Location groups are different from SCIM groups. You cannot search for identities in a location via groups.
